messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Q4 holiday forecast shows a ~48% bump in GPU-hours for hosted across NA & EU for Dec 20-27. Need a short mitigation: reserve vs ephemeral vs packing changes. cc @Jay @Katie
Jay Patel: Do we have per-model heatmaps for that week? seq len distribution matters a lot for packing
Maria Chen: Uploaded sheet: most traffic is chat models, ~512 tokens for 80%. long-tail inference still present.
Ben Ortiz: My quick thought: prewarm small dedicated pools for top tenants and push longtail to dense packing nodes. Avoid one-off prewarms that fragment.
Katie Liao: Reminder: last year we hit network egress throttles when EU bursted to US. Need egress budget in the plan :grimacing:
Samir Rao: I ran a quick time-series on top tenants. Simple ARIMA gave ~30% MAPE but captures the holiday spike. Could be used for predictive prewarms.
Leo Novak: Sim note: slot-slicing + dense-binpack for low-QPS tenants reduced fragmentation by ~18% in our offline sim. Tradeoff is tail latency for cold starts.
Maria Chen: Proposed quick plan: reserve 60% of forecast peak as protected capacity, 25% predictive prewarm based on ARIMA windows, 15% on-need burst to spot with automatic fallback rules.
Jay Patel: Concern: reserved capacity benefits big tenants; longtail could be starved. How do we keep fairness?
Ben Ortiz: Add a min-guarantee for tenants above threshold ($X/mo). For everything else use dynamic fairness with reclaimed slots and preemptible markers.
Katie Liao: Ops checklist draft: 1) prewarm job schedule, 2) egress monitor, 3) cross-region routing dry-run, 4) billing estimate, 5) rollback playbook
ops-bot: Scheduled: prewarm-job v2 -> rollout windows 2023-12-18T04:00Z to 2023-12-19T04:00Z (eu-west, us-east)
Samir Rao: Example prewarm config snippet:
```
{"prewarm": true, "target_hours": 720, "min_priority": 50, "regions": ["eu-west","us-east"]}
```
Maria Chen: Cost note: estimated incremental spend ~$75k (GPU hours + egress). Suggest using INT8/quant profiles for non-critical rerank models to offset cost.
Leo Novak: I'll run an overnight packing sim with the new reserve ratios and post numbers tomorrow morning.
Jay Patel: I'll update the capacity dashboard and add new annotations for the holiday window. tagging owners for runbook updates.
Katie Liao: I'll own prewarm verification and egress alarms this week.
Maria Chen: Thanks — unless objections, we'll lock plan by Friday and start prewarm dry-run. :thumbsup:
